# Teregon Labs

> Teregon Labs is an applied AI and software studio building useful systems for messy data, real decisions, and a living world.

Teregon builds custom software, grounded AI workflows, connected data systems, and nature-led intelligence. The site includes two live client website launches and prior Brio team systems.

## Client websites built and deployed

- **ERIA Events** — https://www.eria.co/ — a Bay Area venues and events site with venue discovery, event stories, press, and a private-event and corporate inquiry journey. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Sanity CMS.
- **W3 Sourcing** — https://www.w3sourcing.com/ — a principal-led executive search site explaining its technology, legal, and finance practices, leadership, methodology, results, and contact path. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript.

## Applied systems and concepts

The site also features BrioBot (evidence-bound support case triage), Briopedia (a git-backed support knowledge base), BrioScope (support analytics), and Brio Sales Navigator (read-only sales forecasting and customer analytics). These are prior Brio product systems built by team members, not Teregon client engagements. “From ridge to river” and “Where heat settles” are illustrative Teregon concepts, not completed client projects.
